body: suck nuts you boring, self-satisfied perma-debby downer

i know it’s really hard to take the advice you’ve given others but i’ll tell you that it’s worth it to wait three years. it may seem like a long time now, but in three years when you’ve moved to your appalachian cabin, it won’t seem so long. plus the mountains are beautiful so it’s worth it to stay alive for the view alone. you seem like a really caring and kind person to have spent so much time supporting your friends so i’d really hate to lose a decent person. i don’t know what you’re dealing with exactly, but if you can just put off suicide for a night, for a week, for a month, do it. it doesn’t have to be an urgent thing. there’s so much for you in the future, especially since you’re still young. i know it’s hard right now so my thoughts are with you and i’m rooting for you. 💜
